title: Learning without relearning physical symmetry: an SO(3)-equivariant convolutional network (CNN) on the sphere
abstract: arXiv:2610.23821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many of the most important datasets in the physical sciences live natively on the sphere, and these data often carry no preferred position or orientation. Using methods that do not reflect this symmetry leads to far higher simulation requirements, which can be catastrophic for scientific analyses (forcing reliance on cheap, imperfect models that bias results). We present a novel spherical implementation of a gauge equivariant mesh architecture that is specifically designed for the Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelization (\healpix{}) of the sphere. The $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-equivariant convolution is built from steerable filters, parallel transport and spin-weighted features. The architecture supplies the exact symmetry, so the network does not spend training data learning it. The convolution operations are constructed to give provably exact equivariance, given a band-limit. Our full CNNs can achieve SO(3)-invariance error at per-ce

translated_title: 无需重新学习物理对称性：球面上的SO(3)等变卷积神经网络（CNN）
translated_abstract: 许多物理科学中最重要的数据集天然存在于球面上，且这些数据通常不带有优先的位置或取向。使用不反映这种对称性的方法会导致高得多的模拟需求，这对科学分析而言可能是灾难性的（迫使人们依赖廉价且不完善的模型，从而使结果产生偏差）。我们提出了一种新颖的球面规范等变网格架构实现，该架构专为球面的层次等面积等纬度像素化（HEALPix）而设计。SO(3)等变卷积由可操纵滤波器、平行移动和自旋加权特征构建而成。该架构直接提供了精确的对称性，因此网络无需花费训练数据去学习它。在给定频带限制的条件下，卷积运算被构建为具有可证明的精确等变性。我们的完整CNN可以将SO(3)不变性误差控制在……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种专为HEALPix球面像素化设计的SO(3)等变卷积神经网络，利用可操纵滤波器、平行移动和自旋加权特征实现可证明的精确等变性，使网络无需消耗训练数据来学习物理对称性。
en_tdlr: We present a novel SO(3)-equivariant CNN specifically designed for HEALPix spherical data, which achieves provably exact equivariance through steerable filters, parallel transport, and spin-weighted features, so the network does not spend training data learning the physical symmetry.
